    (heu : ∀ j, ∀ w ∈ O, 0 ≤ w.1 → f.axial j w = u j w)
    (hep : ∀ j, ∀ w ∈ O, 0 ≤ w.1 → f.phi j w = phi j w)
    (hL : ∀ w ∈ O, CoordinateAlgebra.L h w.2 ≠ 0)
